title.zh: 【美国 SEC 股票代币化豁免规则引发争议，Solana、Hedera 等就公链准入标准提出不同意见】
title.en: 【美国 SEC 股票代币化豁免规则引发争议，Solana、Hedera 等就公链准入标准提出不同意见】

current_state.zh: The SEC's tokenization innovation exemption is drawing competing comment letters over which blockchains qualify as public and permissionless, while more than a third of the companies initially listed for tokenized trading — including Wells Fargo, Arm and Intuit — have objected to their shares being tokenized.
current_state.en: The SEC's tokenization innovation exemption is drawing competing comment letters over which blockchains qualify as public and permissionless, while more than a third of the companies initially listed for tokenized trading — including Wells Fargo, Arm and Intuit — have objected to their shares being tokenized.
